question: As of Dec 2020, who is the Chairman of the National Commission for Backward Classes ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhagwan Lal Sahni**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The National Commission for Backward Classes was established under the National Commission for Backward Classes Act, 1993 on 14th August 1993.
